summary: The RptDestProfileSummary is a user control within the HSPnet application for generating destination profile reports. It involves validation of the destination access list and handles user interface control states.
purpose: To facilitate users in generating destination profile reports within the HSPnet system, providing controls and handling necessary validations.

workflows.name: Generate Destination Profile Report
steps: Check if UserSession is monitoring a user, and hide cmdRunReport if true.
Upon clicking cmdRunReport, obtain the destination access list for the UserSession.
Validate the count of destinations in the list.
If no destinations selected, prompt the user to select at least one destination.
If destinations exceed the maximum allowed, prompt the user with an error.
Construct a destination string from the selected destinations.
Invoke PrintJobs.ReportDestinationProfileCreateJob with the user session and destinations.

validations: Ensure destinations are selected before report generation.
Restrict the number of included destinations to within a set maximum.
conditions: UserSession is monitoring another user (switch view).
Destination access list count is zero.
Destination access list count exceeds maximum allowed.
system_behavior: Hide cmdRunReport if UserSession is monitoring a user.
Display error messages when conditions for report generation are not met.
exceptions: Maximum number of destinations exceeded error.
